description: Returns the clean, watermark-free MP4 link for one Cinematic Background plus an HTML snippet for a muted, looping, autoplaying hero video; this needs a Pro or Lifetime plan. Other plans do not get an error: they get the watermarked preview link, clean: null and the plan required. Use search (kind backgrounds) first to find a slug. A clean file counts toward the same fair-use cap as get_component_source (40 per 10 minutes, 150 a day, 500 a week, never blocking one already opened today). Unknown slugs return an error.

slug.description: Background slug exactly as returned by search (kind backgrounds).
